name_reason: Already compliant with the DPMI naming convention (fd2_dpmi_<descriptor>). 'unlock_size' accurately describes a size-based wrapper that unlocks a region given (base, size), as the sibling 'fd2_dpmi_lock_size'. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Size-based wrapper that unlocks a DPMI page-locked memory region given a base linear address and a size in bytes (instead of start/end addresses).
logic_summary: Computes end = base + size, then tail-calls fd2_dpmi_unlock_region(base, base + size) (DPMI fn 0x601). The callee's int result is returned straight through (EAX is not clobbered between CALL and RET). __cdecl, 8-byte arg cleanup, no stack frame. Sibling of fd2_dpmi_lock_size @ 0x36316.

params.name: base
params.semantics: Base linear byte address of the region to unlock (passed as the 'start' argument to fd2_dpmi_unlock_region).
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; matches the sibling fd2_dpmi_lock_size param naming. No address residue.

params.name: size
params.semantics: Size of the region in bytes; end address is computed as base + size.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; matches the sibling fd2_dpmi_lock_size param naming. No address residue.

returns.semantics: Tail-wrapper passthrough of fd2_dpmi_unlock_region's result: 1 on success (CF clear), 0 on failure. Ghidra decompiler reports void because no current caller consumes the value, but the disassembly confirms EAX carries the callee result straight to RET; src declares int return.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but thinner than the sibling fd2_dpmi_lock_size: it omitted the tail-wrapper return semantics (callee int result passed straight through, decompiler shows void only). Augmented with two lines noting the int passthrough and sibling relationship.
notes: Plate 'void return' line was stale relative to verified behavior; updated to document the int passthrough (EAX not clobbered between CALL 0x362f1 and RET), consistent with src and the sibling fd2_dpmi_lock_size plate. Plate set_plate_comment returned advisory warnings about missing Algorithm/Parameters/Returns section headers; ignored to keep prose form consistent with the sibling. save_program succeeded.
